newsitem.title: FRANCE: Havas seen diluted in Havas Adv growth bid.
newsitem.headline: Havas seen diluted in Havas Adv growth bid.

text.p: Havas Advertising's plans for external growth would involve a dilution in parent Havas's stake, Havas Advertising chairman Alain de Pouzilhac told the company's shareholders on Thursday.
"This operation will therefore not require cash," he told the annual meeting of Havas Advertising.
Havas and its advertising unit have said they were planning a link with an "anglo saxon" advertising agency or network.
De Pouzilhac said the operation should be carried out "in the coming months".
There was no question of Havas pulling out of Havas Advertising entirely, he said.
Havas currently holds 37.7 percent of Havas Advertising.
The current financial year should be "a good year, probably the best" in terms of gross margin and profitability, he added.
